sources.note: DTO generator help page; WebFetch extraction (paraphrase)

claims.statement: DTOs can be generated from any Java/Kotlin class, not only JPA entities.
claims.supports: DTO generation is not limited to JPA entities

claims.statement: By default DTOs are immutable with final fields and no setters; Mutable is off by default.
claims.supports: Mutable off by default; default DTOs immutable with final fields and no setters
